chunks: Muhammad b. Umar al-Hafiz al-Baghdadi narrated to us. He said: Abu Muhammad al-Hasan b. Abdullah b. Muhammad b. Ali b. al-Abbas al-Tamimi al-Razi narrated to me. He said: My father narrated to me. He said: My master Ali b. Musa al-Rida narrated to me. He said: My father Musa b. Ja'far narrated to me. He said: My father Ja'far b. Muhammad narrated to me. He said: My father Muhammad b. Ali narrated to me. He said: My father Ali b. al-Husayn narrated to me. He said: My father al-Husayn b. Ali narrated to me. He said: My father Ali b. Abi Talib (peace be upon him) narrated to me. He said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said:
I and Ali were created from one light.

key_terms.خُلِقْتُ: I was created - in the passive voice, indicating divine creation
key_terms.نُورٍ وَاحِدٍ: One light - referring to the primordial divine light (nur) from which the Prophet and Ali were created before physical existence

ai.seo_question: What is the hadith about the Prophet Muhammad and Ali being created from one light?
ai.summary: This hadith, transmitted through another golden chain of the Twelve Imams, records the Prophet Muhammad declaring that he and Ali were created from a single divine light. This concept of shared primordial creation (nur wahid) is central to Shia theology regarding the special status of Imam Ali and his unique connection to the Prophet, predating physical creation.
